title: 1. Pressure Injuries
source_document: English Master Data Collection & Clinical Content Repository

items.text: Etiology: Unrelieved pressure, shear, friction, and moisture resulting in localized tissue ischemia, capillary occlusion, and cellular necrosis over bony prominences.

sub_items: Stage 1: Non-blanchable erythema of intact skin.
Stage 2: Partial-thickness skin loss with exposed dermis (shallow open ulcer).
Stage 3: Full-thickness skin loss; adipose tissue visible; granulation tissue and epibole present.
Stage 4: Full-thickness skin and tissue loss; exposed bone, tendon, ligament, or muscle.

items.text: Risk Factors: Immobility, sensory loss, incontinence, malnutrition, anemia, microclimate degradation.
